enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +6 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Acid Lore +17: Passive: Your Acid spells gain a 17% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Corrosion +115: Passive: +115 Equipment bonus to Acid Spell Power.
Insightful Corrosion +57: Passive: +57 Insight bonus to Acid Spell Power.
Quality Magical Sheltering +6: +6 Quality bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
